author: AstroPizza
body:
The idea is one block is randomly selected from the map and made the "magic block."If this blocks is mined the players ign will be broadcasted to the game and they will receive a random but positive item/potion effect.I thought of this idea when mining for iron armor as it is quite boring and would be nice if when you were randomly mining you got a nice surprise.

Tell me below what you think.
